card.name: Opening parenthesis before CRS abbreviation
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis right after a spelled-out term such as Cytokine Release Syndrome, where an abbreviation starting with C or similar (CRS) is about to follow. Also the first letter of an abbreviation after its full name.

modes.label: Parenthesis before CRS
modes.description: The bracket after 'Cytokine release syndrome' that introduces the abbreviation CRS.
modes.example: WARNING: CYTOKINE RELEASE SYNDROME Cytokine release syndrome<< (>>CRS), including serious or life-threatening

modes.label: Start of other abbreviations
modes.description: The first letter of an abbreviation after its full name, such as HCV or NCS.
modes.example: National Citizen Service (<<N>>CS) National Citizen Service (NCS

card.writes: It pushes toward abbreviations ending in C, such as GC, SC and RC, and away from mac-type endings.
card.plain: It spots the place where a full name is about to be shortened to an abbreviation like CRS.
